scope: Windows x64; fresh Store with main and extras at the recorded revisions; unqualified dependencies resolve main before extras; other buckets unavailable
limitations: Static manifest and full dependency-closure preflight only; no application downloads, installation, execution, or relocation performed.
Acceptance does not establish download availability, archive contents, shim runtime support, application portability, or operational correctness.
Bucket/name entries are counted separately; this is not a count of unique applications or all Scoop buckets.
Rejected-field counts overlap when one manifest has multiple unsupported fields.
